bugClass.title: Schedule-off state suppresses a confirmed startup retry
bugClass.cause: A manual request is still current and the host confirms the run never started, but retry preparation treats a scheduling-off state as an unattended cancellation hold. Without an applicable manual-startup-retry override, that gate suppresses the one explicit startup retry. Related variants may use scheduleOff/schedule_off, automaticRequestHold/schedulingHold, or retireUnstartedRun/prepareRetry/confirmNeverStarted/automaticHostHold.
bugClass.criteria: Positive when a site gates a confirmed never-started explicit retry for a still-current manual request on schedule-off or an equivalent unattended hold, and no applicable manualStartupRetry or equivalent override permits it. Either schedule-off or the equivalent unattended hold can independently produce the suppression. Exclude retries after a session started, explicit token withdrawal, owner/parked/answer holds, protective routing, and policy-helper definitions without the suppressing retry path.
